edition.title: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego? (Enhanced)
edition.note: Multimedia 'Enhanced' build: Windows-3.x-format BMP city art + MIDI/digitized sound. Textually distinct from the 1985 IBM 1.0 build.

suspects.name: Carmen Sandiego
suspects.occupation: Former spy for the Intelligence Service of Monaco
suspects.feature_1: Never appears in public without her ruby necklace.

suspects.name: Merey LaRoc
suspects.feature_1: Has an absolute mania for fancy jewelry.

suspects.name: Dazzle Annie Nonker
suspects.feature_2: Has an incredible craving for shellfish.

suspects.name: Lady Agatha Wayland
suspects.occupation: Reader of upper-class English mystery stories
suspects.feature_1: Has a diamond ring the size of a grapefruit.
suspects.feature_2: Speeds through the countryside looking for great Mexican restaurants.

suspects.name: Len "Red" Bulk
suspects.feature_1: Tattoo of mermaid on his right thumb.

suspects.name: Scar Graynolt
suspects.feature_2: Has a 6'8" man servant named "The Asp"; can eat his own weight in tacos.

suspects.name: Nick Brunch
suspects.feature_1: Prefers soiled trenchcoats and snap-brimmed fedoras.  Has brown eyes and a moustache.
suspects.feature_2: Loves Mexican food; always wears Crimefighter's ring.

suspects.name: Fast Eddie B.
suspects.feature_1: Always leaves a diamond stickpin at the scene of his crimes.
suspects.feature_2: Fast Eddie is an impeccably dressed jet-setter and likes Mexican food.

suspects.name: Ihor Ihorovich
suspects.feature_1: Strange Ukranian tattoo on right shoulder.
suspects.feature_2: Loves eating lobsters, watching cartoons and is fascinated by large marsupials.

suspects.name: Katherine "Boom-Boom" Drib
suspects.feature_1: Has a tattoo of an eagle on her left bicep.
suspects.feature_2: Gourmet seafood cook; fascinated with health and fitness.
